name: In the Shadow of His Wings
source:
You, the sole heir to the kingdom of Umbrosus, have been kidnapped by a mysterious man named Warden. It's clear what he wants from you isn't ransom; it's something more personal. 

Will you resist, or will you play along?

[Edited from [url=https://void-lit-games.itch.io/in-the-shadow-of-his-wings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你，安布罗苏斯王国的唯一继承人，被一个名叫典狱长的神秘人绑架了。很明显，他想从你这里得到的不是赎金，而是赎金。这是更个人化的事情。

你会反抗，还是会配合？

[编辑自[url=https://void-lit-games.itch.io/in-the-shadow-of-his-wings]itch.io[/url]]
